# Green Pond Dental Associates

> Advanced family and cosmetic dentistry practice in North Jersey led by Dr. Bracha Lubart, offering comprehensive dental services across multiple locations.

Green Pond Dental Associates operates multiple offices in Jackson, Rockaway, Toms River, and Denville, NJ, providing family dentistry, cosmetic procedures, implant dentistry, and full-mouth reconstruction. The practice accepts major insurance plans including Delta Dental, Blue Cross Blue Shield, and Cigna.
